summary: Google DeepMind released version 0.6.0 of the AlphaGenome library, adding new scoring and variant-property options and reducing peak memory usage during tensor unpacking by 50%.

practices.reason: The library's own memory footprint during tensor unpacking is halved, a reproducible efficiency gain for anyone using this specific tool.
practices.quote: Reduce peak memory usage by 50% when unpacking tensors.

practices.reason: New API options (no-center-mask scoring, GTF splice site processing, additional variant properties) change what calls the library supports, requiring minor integration updates for existing users.
practices.quote: Support for making interval scoring requests with no center mask.
